messages:
claire: Vendor pen-test confirmed for 2026-02-10 09:00-13:00 UTC. Scope: RBAC delta reviews, KMS integration points, audit export. Need a concise pre-test checklist and retest rules.
omar: Proposed RBAC freeze 08:30-14:30 UTC. Exemptions only via /sec-exceptions and explicit approver sign-off. Safelist: ci-runner, observability-agent.
lin: KMS access: create role kms-audit-pt with DescribeKey, ListKeys, GetKeyRotationStatus, ListAliases; explicitly deny Decrypt/Encrypt/GenerateDataKey*. Assessors must not access key material.
claire: Evidence bundle format: one tar per domain (rbac.tgz, kms.tgz, logs.tgz). Top-level manifest.txt with sha256 checksums and exporter name. Upload to s3://pt-evidence/2026-02/<vendor>/ and tag pt:2026-02.
omar: Retest SLA proposal: Critical (active exploit) -> 48h hotfix + retest; High -> 5 days; Medium -> 14 days; Low -> next sprint. All fixes touching auth/KMS require regression evals.
lin: Quick RBAC freeze script: `scripts/pen-test-freeze --apply` and `--revert`. Only sec-lead posts FREEZE_RELEASE and runs `--revert` after canaries green.
devops-bot: Canary run scheduled 2026-02-10 08:15 UTC against safelisted services. Will post results.
claire: Add attestation.pdf into bundle listing allowed/denied accesses and who exported artifacts. PII must be redacted or marked sensitive.
pt-bot: Created epic PT-2026-02 (https://vuln.redwood.local/epic/PT-2026-02) and reserved tentative retest slot 2026-02-12 09:00-11:00 UTC. Assigned owners: omar, lin.
omar: I'll prepare safelist patch and RBAC playbook today. Please ack when done.
lin: ack
claire: ack
